# netbox Provider

Manage the [vault-plugin-secrets-netbox](https://github.com/IUCLabs/vault-plugin-secrets-netbox) secrets engine (mount, config and roles) on HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao. The plugin must already be registered in the server's plugin catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netbox = {
      source = "IUCLabs/vault-secrets-netbox"
    }
  }
}

# address defaults to $VAULT_ADDR, token to $VAULT_TOKEN.
provider "netbox" {
  address = "https://vault.example.com:8200"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the Vault/OpenBao server. Falls back to the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token used to authenticate to Vault/OpenBao. Falls back to the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable.
